key_insight: This review connects reinforcement learning with PDE-constrained optimization to assess feedback control of complex dynamical systems.
engineering_relevance: RL offers a route to adaptive, real-time control of distributed systems, but training efficiency and scalability remain key engineering challenges.
method: Unifies perspectives from RL and PDE-constrained optimization.
Surveys model-free, model-based, and multi-agent RL approaches.
Examines sample efficiency, parameter generalization, and high-dimensional scalability.
evidence_signal: Two demonstrations—chaotic-system stabilization and flow control—illustrate performance and pitfalls; the abstract reports no quantitative results.
watch_item: Reliable deployment requires validation across operating conditions, since generalization and data-efficient training remain open challenges.
paper_title: Reinforcement learning for control of partial differential equations
